source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Excel_Generation') AS OLE_DB_Source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Excel_Generation') AS OLE_DB_Source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Excel_Generation_CC') AS OLE_DB_Source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Excel_Generation_CC') AS OLE_DB_Source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolderDELETE__ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolderDELETE_') AS MoveToBusFolderDELETE__ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolderDELETE__FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolderDELETE_') AS MoveToBusFolderDELETE__FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolderDELETE__FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolderDELETE_') AS MoveToBusFolderDELETE__FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE__ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE_') AS MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE__ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE__FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE_') AS MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE__FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE__FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE_') AS MoveToBusFolder_CCDELETE__FilePath;
